decisions.rationale: The temporal before contrasts with simultaneous death. Full SNGA glossary directly attests before; initial capital is verse lineation.
The first coordinator presents alternatives before or together. Full DANG permits or; no second English or is reused.
The complete lexical temporal adverb is together, exactly attested. Do not split equal/du or duplicate its rendering.
The single death predicate governs both temporal alternatives and owns die once. Supplied those who remains unwrapped.
La marks the persons for whom an actual stage does not occur. Its unique for follows stage; the later causal for is distinct.
The verse abbreviates the actual stage as dngos. Select directly attested actual only; supplied explanatory stage remains unwrapped instead of inventing a gzhi syllable.
The explicit negative existential is represented by no. There is is English existential support and does not need a separate invented Tibetan copula.
Lus is body. The apostrophe separates contracted has in body's; only the complete lexical body base is claimed, not an unhyphenated interior stem or a composed auxiliary.
The other/new body is another in the rebirth explanation. GZHAN has unrelated auto-mined a bodhisattva; local source/reference another support this provisional claim, without promotion.
Exact SKYES glossary born. The English contracted perfect auxiliary remains outside.
Exact DMAG glossary war; article and surrounding locative framing remain outside.
Complete enumerative formula closes the war-or-similar-activity category, rendered or whatever. It owns no supplied noun; whole formula kept at d6, without separately assigning internal la/par to in.
Don is the goal/purpose shared by participants. Full DON attests goal; contracted is after its apostrophe and supplied their remain outside.
Gcig supplies identity of the goal, exactly glossary same. Do not add the article or equate this occurrence with the later agent one.
This correctly spelled phyir gives the reason for shared responsibility and owns Because. The earlier raw phyer remains unbanked and is separately screened.
The entire quantifier is All, directly attested, and names every participant.
Complete agent compound directly attests one who commits. Exclude the article and anaphoric it; no speculative byed/commits or po/one child.

The comparison equates liability with that of the actual agent, locally as much as. BZHIN auto-mined let's say is irrelevant; comparative reference and complete local syntax support the provisional relation.
Full LDAN directly attests possess. English it recalls the actual stage and remains outside this verb.
